summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-named identifiers, wrapped dispatch objects) and downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, unzips it to a temporary directory, chmods the extracted `bun` binary executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-cjs bundle whose contents are obfuscated with a shuffled/rotated string-array lookup pattern (`n7gIxM=[...]` array plus a `WV8StW` array-rotator function). The package advertises itself as a Prettier configuration, which does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime nor a large opaque compiled bundle. The install-time flow drops and executes an alternate runtime purely to run a bundled opaque payload that Node-based tooling cannot inspect, concealing the payload's actual behavior from installers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
